facts.text: Serve the main when Nora finally gets her hands on the last ham.
facts.why: Nora never gets the ham. The honey ham rolls into the street and is smashed by a truck, and she comes home with smoked trout instead. Wikipedia and Wikiquote both have the trout, and Luther's 'What happened to the hickory honey ham?'
facts.fix: Serve the main when the neighbours rally round for the Christmas Eve party.

vibe.verdict: A neat recipe box kitchen with the right street and snowman, but the main cue gets the ham wrong and it skips the funniest disasters.
missing: The honey ham rolling into the street under a truck (Christmas Eve)
Luther icing the carollers off the lawn
Nora coming home with only smoked trout
Luther borrowing Wes Trogdon's tree and the police turning up
Frosty falling off the roof with Luther
The Scheels, Walt and Bev, and the cruise Luther hands over
ideas: Swap 'Nora's last honey glazed ham' note for the line where the ham rolls into the street.
Swap 'Caribbean cruise prawn cocktail' for 'Smoked trout, the party fallback' to use the trout.
Swap the cue to 'Serve the main when Frosty falls off the roof' for a physical beat.
Swap 'Last-minute Christmas Eve trifle' note for the Scheels' cruise ending.
